Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd

Class Invoker

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.Invoker
public class Invoker extends Object
Represents the source or context from which a command was invoked.

A command can be invoked by their following classifications:

  • User: The user explicitly typed this command out in the command line (or it has been pasted) and they hit enter in the command lin and it executed. Can only set CommandParser#run()
  • Engine: Anything else the user does, but does not have to go through the command line text input. So clicking a button or a keyboard shortcut, all count as engine invocations. set within CommandParser.run(Command, ArrayList, ArrayList) overload
  • fromParent: This specific command was invoked as a result of a parent command calling it. This specifically indicates that this was invoked as a Subcommand of the stored parent. This is set only by Command#dispatchToSubcommands(String, SafeJLabel, Object[], ArrayList)
  • fromCall: If another command call specifically calls some other command. The command has to use the CommandParser.run(Command, ArrayList, ArrayList, Command) overload.

Lehlogonolo Poole
